digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest timeout configuration
propositions: CI workflow files from trusted main permanently shadow pytest-timeout ini values via CLI flag precedence, preventing patchsets from testing their own timeout budget changes in the Verified gate

The two shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) in _build-and-test.yml carry explicit --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread CLI flags that must be removed and replaced with single-sourcing from [tool.pytest.ini_options] in pyproject.toml

Removing the explicit CLI timeout flags from the two shared-tier lanes requires rewriting parity contract tests to assert flag-free execution and verifying the ini timeout configuration remains the hang guard
The effective budget remains unchanged (300 seconds, thread method) when moving timeout authority from CLI flags to the ini, only the configuration source changes
